dramatic_question: 洪水会吞没神州，还是山顶异光带来转机？
turning_point: 通天峰金光出现；水面压力开始减弱。

script.title: 通天峰 · 洪水与金光（链路样片）

scenes.scene_description: An empty boat rocks in a fast flooded river below Tongtian Peak at night. Rain and water move throughout the frame.
scenes.source_text: 第三天夜里通天峰顶上金光闪闪

scenes.scene_description: The same stormy flood scene continues. A restrained golden light behind the peak grows and the nearest waves begin to lose force.
